title: Lake Minnetonka Sunday Brunch Cruise
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a delightful brunch while cruising on beautiful Lake Minnetonka every Sunday. This 2-hour cruise features a full buffet with fresh seasonal fruits, scrambled eggs, pan-fried potatoes, and an assortment of pastries, ensuring a satisfying meal as you soak in the scenic views. Sip on orange juice and coffee as you unwind on the water, making it the perfect way to wrap up your weekend. Ideal for families and friends looking to enjoy a leisurely day out on the lake.
